summary: Our project is a short animated documentary and gaming featuring four NASA exploration vehicles on the Moon and Mars. We believe their discoveries and legacy deserve to be remembered for generations to explore, innovate, and reach beyond the stars.
details:
• Product Description

A 5–6 minute 2D animated science documentary and game featuring four NASA exploration vehicles: Lunar Roving Vehicle, Sojourner, Spirit, and Opportunity. Each character tells its own story through animation, narration, and real NASA images.

  • Benefits

  • - Raises awareness of NASA's abandoned exploration equipment.
  • - Makes space science engaging and easy to understand.
  • - Preserves the scientific legacy of past missions.
  • - Inspires young people to explore science and technology.

  • Team Goals

To bring forgotten NASA explorers back to life through creative storytelling, inspire the next generation of space explorers, and develop our research, creativity, digital technology, English communication, and teamwork skills.

  • Our Key Message: “Missions may end, but discoveries and inspiration last forever.”
